name: Praying In A Closet
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of private, sincere prayer over public displays of piety, instructing believers to seek God in solitude and humility. Jesus teaches that prayer should be done in a closed room, away from the eyes of men, where God who sees in secret will reward openly (Matthew 6:6). This intimate communion with God invites believers to call upon Him with faith, promising that He will answer and reveal mighty, hidden things (Jeremiah 33:3). The call to enter one’s chambers and shut the doors (Isaiah 26:20) underscores the need for focused, undistracted prayer that aligns the heart with God’s will, trusting in His faithful response (Matthew 21:22).
